title: Earl Hines forgot his own number at Montreux
summary: Making the live record at Montreux, Earl Hines forgot his song 'You Can Depend on Me' and Humes had to sing the whole thing to him.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: Yeah, that's lovely. You told me one funny thing about Earl (Hines) when you made that record session with him, when they recorded that live at Montreux. You said you were doing one of Earl's numbers and he didn't remember the number and you had to sing it to him.
And you told me, that was, 'You Can Depend On Me'.

S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC.
WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
And you had to sing him that release?
Yeah, I had to sing everything. I said, that's your number Earl and he said, I forgot it.
